name: HeibruClient

launcher.notes: Electron bundle for local launcher usage. Run with: npm install && npm start from launcher/

client.notes: Fabric client jar ready to be used with a local Minecraft installation.

usage: 1. Open the launcher bundle in release/HeibruClient-<timestamp>/launcher
2. Install dependencies in launcher/ with npm install
3. Start the launcher with npm start
4. Use the copied client jar from release/HeibruClient-<timestamp>/client
